newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania monthly inflation jumps to 10.3 pct in Dec.
newsitem.headline: Romania monthly inflation jumps to 10.3 pct in Dec.

text.p: Romania's monthly inflation soared to 10.3 percent last December, almost double 5.8 percent level of the previous month, the National Statistics Board (CNS) data showed on Friday.
Year-on-year inflation surged to 56.9 percent last December from November's 47.4 percent, nearly triple the 20 percent target agreed with the International Monetary Fund for 1996.
Romania's new centrist ruling coalition cabinet is now working on a reform package aimed at restoring economic stability and accelerating structural reforms.
Romanian officials resumed loan negotiations with the International Monetary Fund in Bucharest, in parallel with ongoing talks with the World Bank.
Both international lenders withheld loan tranches for Romania last year over slow reforms and overspending by the former ruling leftists in an electoral year, which reignited inflation.
